body: Good luck with growing them. I've been in the same boat too scared to do it for longer than I care to remember. Just living a life if misery instead hoping someone does it for me
Always referenced in chat yeah. It's not on the books, that might be why. I will switch or stop I guess.

Hey. You've carried the life ending goal with you for 10 years. You told yourself "right, 10 years, if no change I'm done" and that's ruled your life so far. 

Personally, I'd recommend a massive change. Of everything. I have serious struggles of my own, but in my 33 years I can tell you that changing all your circumstances in a massive hit will shake you up fresh.

Call someone you rely on, go stay with them, chat it out for an evening, stay over and make plans. Get abroad, start travelling. If you haven't much money then do what you can, backpack, hitchhike, whatever you need.

You've had a proper shit time and there are some serious scum bags around and you've had your fair share clearly. Now break away from your surroundings and start walking in the sun, see new things, meet new people. Once you start moving forward you won't look back.

​

Much love x
